latest.title: Enterprise facilitators adopt AWS Leadership Card Game for live leadership drills
latest.description: Organizations running builder academies and leadership circles today can adopt AWS Leadership Card Game as a live facilitation format for short, high-intensity leadership drills that fit inside existing meetings—not outside them. Unlike multi-day offsites that fade by Monday, AWS Leadership Card Game is designed for in-room rehearsal: each participant holds three cards, speaks under time pressure, and practices side-effect honesty when a choice creates operational or trust cost.

latest.title: Why Isn't the AWS Blocks Agent Built on AgentCore? What the Repository Reveals About What's Next
latest.description: The AWS Blocks Agent doesn't run on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. On main it composes the Strands Agents SDK with AsyncJob, Realtime, FileBucket and DistributedTable, which deploy to Lambda, SQS, API Gateway WebSocket, S3 and DynamoDB. The repository, though, holds a five-PR stack proposing a move to AgentCore Runtime, plus a separate PR adding Memory, Gateway and Identity as Blocks. All are still drafts. A contributor's reading of what replacing the inside of the Agent Block would mean.

latest.description: 「設計はできた。さあコードを書こう」と思ったとき、何から手をつけますか？ どの順番で？ 並列にできるものは？ V2のConstruction phaseは「ただコードを生成する」のではなく、Unit・Bolt・Batchという構造で実行順序と並列性を制御しています。シリーズ第11回。

latest.title: Build AI Agent Harnesses in a Free Sandbox Workshop
latest.description: Building AI agent harnesses with the open-source Strands Agents SDK is now something you can practice in a real AWS environment, for free, without setting up an account.
